events.title: European banks show mixed results as HSBC profits dip while UniCredit's rise
events.body: HSBC reported a slight contraction in profits while Italy's UniCredit surpassed market expectations as banking institutions navigate a complex landscape defined by geopolitical tensions.View on euronews

events.title: Santander completes near £3bn takeover of rival TSB
events.body: The deal sees the combined group become the UK’s third biggest bank for current accounts and fourth for mortgages.

events.title: Ebury secures around £550m to expand cross-border payments platform
events.body: Ebury platform enables payments in more than 140 currencies across 160 countries.

events.title: Banco Santander SA (SAN) Q1 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Record Profit and Strong Capital Position
events.body: Banco Santander SA (SAN) reports a 12% profit increase and an all-time high CET1 capital ratio, despite challenges in Argentina and the UK.
